messages:
emily_sales: Quick sync — customer (BigBank) asked whether we can ship a fully offline installer that supports delta updates and signed images. They also want upgrade cadence locked to 6 months and emergency hotpatches allowed.

matt_se: We can produce an offline bundle + signed manifest. Need to confirm: do they require per-node activation tokens or a central license server inside their network?

emily_sales: central license server inside their airgap, no outbound. They want activation to work via one-time QR code or signed token they paste during install.

matt_se: OK. For offline activation we typically support a license token file + HMAC signature. We can add support for signed license envelopes that are validated by our agent using embedded public key. That avoids KMS calls.

sarah_security: Also flag: they need SBOM + vulnerability scan results for the exact bundle. We must include reproducible build hashes and signature chain. Legal will want attestation.

legal_amy: Confirming — we need entitlements in SOW to allow 90 days of emergency CVE patches backports. Pricing implication?

matt_se: Pricing-wise, offline support + signed bundle creation is a professional services add-on. For POC we can do a one-time bundle at no charge if we get commitment. If cadence is 6mo with emergency patches, recommend Dedicated seat pricing + support addon.

ops_jon: Ops note: their environment disallows outbound NTP. Time drift can break cert validation. We need to support a permissive time window or use monotonic counters in signatures.

matt_se: Good catch. We can implement certificate validation that checks signature timestamps AND accepts a grace window of X hours, or rely solely on signature chain with no timestamp. Need security sign-off.

sarah_security: We prefer timestamp-free verification and a signed manifest with nonce during activation. But that'll require an additional activation step where customer runs `redwood-activate --nonce-file <file>` offline.

matt_se: Example install snippet:
````
./install.sh --bundle redwood-offline-2026-03.tar.gz 
redwood-activate --nonce-file /tmp/nonceresp.json --license /tmp/license.sig
````

emily_sales: Customer asked about delta updates: they can't accept full reimage every patch. Can we ship delta deltas (patch chunks) and a staged apply? Also require rollback path.

matt_se: We have a delta bundle format but depends on patch size. For big quantized model deltas it's large. Recommend model sharding + patch-at-runtime for weights; otherwise full bundle. Rollback supported via snapshotting.

sarah_security: They also want HSM integration for signing inside their enclave later. We'll need to supply PKCS#11 hooks in our signing tooling. Mark P1.

legal_amy: I'll draft SOW language for offline support, patch cadence, and IP terms. Emily, can you get acceptance on 6mo + emergency 90d window?

emily_sales: On it, I'll update customer and loop back. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: offline-bundle-gen job queued for 2026-03-15 10:00 UTC

matt_se: I'll prepare a test bundle and run through offline install in our CI env. Expect results by EOD Friday.
